#!/bin/bash
# P24 stage A at main 0c1edbc: fixtures, ingest, whole verify, then each step alone.
set -u
L=$1; R=$L/p24; M=/Users/zahidaramai/Local_Sites/seis-mdio-zarr; mkdir -p $R; cd $M
PYTHONPATH=$M .venv/bin/python - $R <<'PY'
import sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from tests.fixtures.generators.poststack3d import make_poststack3d
want = {"small": "ac6001f611319a41d45d2729844d834c10ad340d0ce8a2f94f620796927ca03a",
        "large": "2b8b7aa0851771ae8d2981ed173de63f7dd94f0b50124d3a7bf2881b9cd3eb2e"}
r = Path(sys.argv[1])
for name, ni in (("small", 150), ("large", 600)):
    p = make_poststack3d(r / f"{name}.sgy", n_inline=ni, n_crossline=630, n_samples=1000).path
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 24), b""): h.update(b)
    assert h.hexdigest() == want[name], (name, h.hexdigest())
    print("fixture", name, "sha256 ok", flush=True)
PY
[ $? -eq 0 ] || { echo "FIXTURE MISMATCH, stopped"; exit 3; }
for n in small large; do
  .venv/bin/sdip ingest $R/$n.sgy $R/$n.mdio > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "ingest $n exit $?"
  /usr/bin/time -l .venv/bin/sdip verify --json --skip-portability --envelope-gib 0 $R/$n.sgy $R/$n.mdio > $R/$n.verify.json 2> $R/$n.verify.time
  echo "whole $n exit $? $(grep 'maximum resident' $R/$n.verify.time)"
  for s in baseline binding preflight g1 plane_1 plane_2 plane_3 plane_4 plane_5 trace_map store_digest content_digest; do
    out=$(PYTHONPATH=$M .venv/bin/python $L/p24_step.py $s $R/$n.sgy $R/$n.mdio 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
    echo "$n $out"
  done
done

"""P24 diagnosis (not gated): Plane 3's parts, each alone, peak RSS."""
import json, resource, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
if __name__ == "__main__":
    part, source, store = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3])
    from sdip.cli.main import _declaration
    from sdip.equivalence.planes import _open_source, _open_store
    spec = _declaration("1", "PostStack3DTime", None, None).build_spec().segy_spec
    handle = _open_source(source, spec); group = _open_store(store)
    if part == "source_headers": h = handle.header[:]
    elif part == "store_headers": h = group["headers"][:]
    elif part == "store_raw_header_plane": h = np.asarray(group["headers_raw_uint8"][:])
    elif part == "source_header_bytes_memmap_touched":
        from sdip.ingest.header_plane import read_source_header_bytes, sample_bytes, trace_data_offset
        m = read_source_header_bytes(source, samples_per_trace=int(handle.samples_per_trace), bytes_per_sample=sample_bytes(spec), data_offset=trace_data_offset(handle))
        s = 0
        for i in range(m.shape[0]): s += int(m[i][0])
    print(json.dumps({"part": part, "ru_maxrss": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}))
